what.text: This page follows internal displacement in Argentina, as recorded by IDMC.
IDMC's year-end count of people still displaced by disasters went from 13 in 2016 to 815 in 2025.

why.text: IDMC's disaster records for Argentina list floods, storms, wildfires, mass movements and extreme temperatures.
The fact pack records no armed conflict for Argentina in these years.

when.text: The main year of displacement in the data is 2025.

how.text: In 2025, IDMC recorded 32080 new displacements by disasters: these count movements, not people.
The sources don't say where people went inside Argentina.
